name: adcp-modular-extensions-example
description: Stable AdCP core + digest-pinned extension modules + modular SDK codegen (example for the modular AdCP proposal)

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:ext && npm run codegen && npm run sdk && npm run typecheck
scripts.sdk: node scripts/adcp-sdk.mjs examples/buyer-app && node scripts/adcp-sdk.mjs examples/sales-agent && node scripts/adcp-sdk.mjs test/apps/superset && node scripts/adcp-sdk.mjs test/apps/governance-only
scripts.sdk:check: node scripts/adcp-sdk.mjs examples/buyer-app --check && node scripts/adcp-sdk.mjs examples/sales-agent --check && node scripts/adcp-sdk.mjs test/apps/superset --check && node scripts/adcp-sdk.mjs test/apps/governance-only --check
